Card Q&A.q: I used this Digimon's [When Digivolving] effect to DNA digivolve, and this caused the memory gauge to move to my opponent's side. This brought the end of the turn. Can I use this card's inherited effect to DNA digivolve again?

Card Q&A.a: No, the target original "1 of your other Digimon" for this effect does not have to be purple.
Card Q&A.q: If I use this card's [When Digivolving] effect to digivolve into a level 4 purple Digimon, does my other Digimon have to be purple?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Activate 1 of the effects below.
・1 of your other Digimon may digivolve into a level 4 purple Digimon card with [Free] in its traits from your trash for the cost.
・This Digimon and one of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand for the cost.
Inherited Effect: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and one of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in your hand for the cost.
